title: All 19 SAT Math Skills Explained
description:
The SAT Math section is built from exactly 19 skills in four domains. This video goes through every one in the College Board's order, with an SAT-style practice question for each, a fast solution, and a Desmos shortcut where it actually helps.

You'll see:
• Algebra: linear equations, linear functions, systems, and inequalities
• Advanced Math: equivalent expressions, nonlinear equations and systems, nonlinear functions
• Problem-Solving and Data Analysis: rates and units, percentages, statistics, scatterplots, probability, margin of error, and studies vs. experiments
• Geometry and Trigonometry: area and volume, lines and triangles, right-triangle trig, and circles
• How to turn your misses into a study plan

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank and filter by skill.
